brief:
Aber Kawas won election to the New York state Senate, making history as the first Palestinian to serve in that chamber, Al Jazeera English reported. The Democratic Socialist candidate secured 74.5 percent of the vote in his race.

Kawas campaigned on a progressive platform during the election. His victory puts a Palestinian in the state Senate for the first time.
dek: Kawas, a democratic socialist, won with 74.5 percent of the vote, championing progressive politics.
title: Aber Kawas elected first Palestinian to New York state Senate
